name: mnemosyne
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code across sessions and repos, on its own private copy of the Mnemopi engine and its own store (never omp's).

scope.title: Memory scope
scope.description: global: one memory shared by every repo. per-project: each repo keeps its own, and facts saved as global are seen everywhere.

memoryDir.title: Memory store
memoryDir.description: Where the memory database lives. Keep it away from ~/.omp: one store, one writer.

rememberTerms.title: Remember terms
rememberTerms.description: A prompt that opens with one of these asks Claude to save the rest as a memory. Matched at the start only, case-insensitive. Empty list turns it off.

recallTerms.title: Recall terms
recallTerms.description: A prompt that opens with one of these recalls memories for the rest of it, on that prompt. Matched at the start only, case-insensitive. Empty list turns it off.

externalMcp.title: Share with other MCP clients
externalMcp.description: Writes ~/.claude/mnemosyne/bin/mnemosyne-mcp, a stdio MCP server other tools (Cursor, Codex, claude mcp add) can launch against this store. Off removes it.
